summary: QA SDET 1: Responsible for manual and automation testing of software products, working with development and product teams to deliver high-quality features.
responsibilities: Manual and automation testing for software products
Working in partnership with development and product teams
Building automated testing solutions for application, services, and database testing requirements
required_skills: 1-3 years of work experience in testing web, mobile, and backend applications
Good understanding of STLC and experience working in agile teams
Mobile testing and automation using Appium
nice_to_have_skills: Performance testing using JMeter or similar tools
Network response mocking and debugging tools like Charles, Fiddler
